locator: Table 3, Tandem walk rows; Methods/Participants and Methods/Tandem walk
title: Effects of intermittent seating upright, lower body negative pressure, and exercise on functional tasks performance after head-down tilt bed rest
authors: Clément G, Moudy SC, Macaulay TR, Mulder E and Wood SJ (2024)
population: 47 adults; Earth-based 30-day 6° head-down tilt bed rest at DLR:envihab, SANS-CM.

groups.context: 60 min aerobic cycle exercise 6 days/week followed by 6 h venous-occlusive thigh cuffs
Daily 2 × 3 h lower body negative pressure at 25 mmHg

endpoint: Tandem walking; percentage of correct heel-to-toe steps
measurement: 10 steps per trial, two trials each with eyes closed/open; video scored by three reviewers using median reviewer assessment per trial.
uncertainty: Published mean ± SD; SD is not a confidence interval or paired-change uncertainty.
transformation: Original numerical transcription; after minus before using rounded published means, rounded to 2 decimal places; percentage points.
limitations: Ground analog group summaries do not predict individual astronaut or Mars outcomes.
Endpoint-specific paired n and paired-change covariance are not supplied here. No confidence interval is reconstructed.
The Table 4 tandem label uses time (s); this register follows Table 3 percent and Methods correct-step definition without silently correcting the publication.
